I will grow this maize much like last season, but I will put inputs first on this main plot because it is my own land and it feeds the house. I have some schooling, so I look at the cost and the chance of getting a return, and if I can get fertilizer and hybrid seed in time I will use them, but not at a very heavy rate because cash is tight. I also keep manure for this plot, and I will not spend money on pesticide unless I see a real problem. I depend on the rains here, so I will not irrigate.
